title: Implement asynchronous VCF Operations for Logs cluster join
prompt: Implement the VCF Operations for Logs 9.0 asynchronous cluster-join client in the provided `vcf_logs` package using only the Python standard library and the supplied `docs/contract.json`. Complete `VCFLogsClient.join_cluster_and_wait(master_fqdn, *, master_port=None, accept_cert=None)` so it starts the join with `POST_deployment-join`, then repeatedly calls `POST_deployment-waitUntilStarted` until that status operation returns its terminal HTTP 200 response. A documented HTTP 500 from the status operation is retryable; other non-success responses must raise `VCFLogsAPIError`. Return the JSON object from the initial join response after the terminal status is reached. Requests must use the `/api/v2` paths and JSON wire shapes in the contract. When `master_port` or `accept_cert` is `None`, omit that property from the JSON object entirely; when set, preserve its value, including `False`. Status polls have no request body. Use `poll_interval` between retryable polls, with no sleep when it is zero. Do not add third-party dependencies.
